buildCommand: export PATH="/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter create . --platforms web --project-name upchat && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --base-href /
installCommand: cd /tmp && if [ ! -d flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 flutter; fi && export PATH="/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter --version && flutter precache --web
